nodes.text:
The first case of HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) has been detected in Bengaluru. An 8-month-old baby has tested positive for the virus.

Amidst the rising concerns, @MoHFW_INDIA officials are downplaying the situation saying “no need for alarm”. Didn’t they say something similar https://t.co/J7NHnhAop6

nodes.text: @NilanjanDasAITC @MoHFW_INDIA @MamataOfficial @narendramodi @JPNadda @ItsYourDev @derekobrienmp @jawharsircar @SushmitaDevAITC @SMitra_ @aitcShantanu @PritishRoyAITC History echoes in Bengaluru. The first case of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is here, yet officials reassure there's ‘no need for alarm.’ Sound familiar? COVID-19 taught us that early ignorance fuels future crises. Will we repeat the same mistake?
